tagline: Autonomous decision intelligence for enterprise teams
bio: NovaMind AI was founded in 2023 to bring production-grade autonomous agents to mid-market enterprises. We combine large language model orchestration with deterministic rule engines to deliver explainable decisions at scale. Headquartered in New York, with 28 employees and 3 design partners generating $180k ARR.
executive_summary: NovaMind AI has achieved product-market fit in the legal workflow automation vertical, with 3 paying enterprise customers and a pipeline of $2.1M ARR. The core differentiation is our hybrid explainable AI layer — customers can audit every decision the system makes. This report covers competitive positioning, revenue trajectory, technical audit, and strategic roadmap for Q3–Q4 2026.

key_assumptions: 3 new enterprise logos per quarter at $80k ACV
Existing customers expand by 30% in year 2

risk_items.mitigation: Deepen vertical integration and proprietary data moats; compete on explainability and compliance features hyperscalers cannot offer

risk_items.risk: LLM hallucination in high-stakes legal workflows
risk_items.mitigation: Deterministic rule overlay on all LLM outputs; mandatory human review gate for category-A decisions

risk_items.risk: Runway below 12 months if Q3 ARR target missed
risk_items.mitigation: Maintain rolling 13-week cash forecast; activate bridge raise at 8-month runway trigger

risk_items.risk: EU AI Act compliance requirements for high-risk AI systems
risk_items.mitigation: Engage external counsel for AI Act readiness assessment Q2 2026; build audit log export into core product

roadmap_items.milestone: Launch self-serve tier with usage-based billing
API v2 with streaming decision responses

ai_narratives.executive_overview: NovaMind AI occupies a defensible position at the intersection of enterprise compliance requirements and the operational efficiency unlocked by large language models. The company's explainability-first architecture is not a product differentiator — it is a prerequisite for adoption in regulated industries. This positions NovaMind ahead of horizontal LLM providers who cannot offer the audit trails and decision provenance that legal, financial, and healthcare teams require.
ai_narratives.growth_analysis: The current growth rate of 22% MoM is healthy but must be assessed against customer concentration risk: three customers represent 100% of ARR. The Q3 self-serve launch is the critical inflection point — success here diversifies revenue and provides a low-cost acquisition channel to supplement the current high-touch enterprise sales motion. CAC reduction to below $4,000 is achievable if the self-serve funnel converts at or above 3%.
ai_narratives.risk_summary: The two risks requiring immediate board attention are LLM hallucination in high-stakes workflows and runway exposure. Both are manageable with existing resources. The deterministic rule overlay is technically sound; the gap is documentation and external audit coverage needed for enterprise procurement. The runway risk is a planning problem, not a business model problem — the unit economics at scale are compelling.
